bandReport.notes: Band is Q64-90, 27 questions, contiguous and gap-free. The five PNGs are printed pages 23-A, 25-A, 27-A, 29-A, 31-A — the booklet is bilingual and only the odd (English) pages were rendered, so the page-number jump of 2 is expected and does NOT indicate missing questions; numbering runs 64->90 unbroken across p11..p15. Band edges checked against territory I do not own: p10 (printed 21-A) ends with a complete option block in BOTH columns, so nothing spills into Q64, which begins at the head of p11's left column; p16 opens at Q91 (left column) and Q93 (right column), so nothing spills out of Q90, whose option (d) is the last line of p15's right column. Column-break hazard checked explicitly at the foot of every left column and the head of every right column on all five pages: NO question's option block splits across a column break anywhere in this band — each block sits whole beneath its own stem in its own column. Every option set re-checked label->text against the page at 5-7x crops for Q64-66, 68, 70-72, 74-77, 79-83, 85-86, 88, 90 (proper nouns and short-option sets crop-verified individually: Samahartri/Dauvarika/Akshapatala/Samnidhatri; Siachen/Chungphar/Zemu/Gasherbrum with Nubra Valley/Kumaon-Garhwal/Central Nepal/Pir Panjal; Gajapati/Ashvapati/Narapati; Hokera/Point Calimere/Tsomoriri/Wular; Nevado Ojos del Salado; Dhaulagiri/Namcha Barwa/Kamet/Makalu). Q65, Q70 and Q71 are numbered-pair lists rendered as GFM pipe tables per Rule 2; the page prints NO column headers for any of the three, so the parenthesised headers are derived from each stem's own wording ('High Offices and concerned Departments', 'Himalayan Glaciers and their location') or, for Q70 which has none, a neutral '(Title)' / '(Refers to)'. Q65/Q70's List-I entries are set in italics on the page (transliterated Sanskrit terms) and are transcribed as plain text since the emphasis is not load-bearing; the italics in Q70's 'Rayas of Vijayanagara' are likewise decorative. No page defects: no misprint, no impossible value, no duplicated option, no missing fourth option — all 27 questions print exactly four options labelled (a)-(d). Three question-shape notes for the deriver: Q78, Q79 and Q87 are assertion-reason questions using the 'With regard to the statements given above' four-way code, and Q68's stem prints 'Which of the following statements is/are correct ?' BEFORE its four statements rather than after, which is how the page reads. One catalog gap flagged on Q90 (see its flags entry).
